Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.mfa

Interface SecondFactorAttemptRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
JdbcSecondFactorAttemptRepository
public interface SecondFactorAttemptRepository
Port that keeps the failed second-factor attempts of each user, so that a lockout survives restarts and is shared by every instance of the server.

    Method
    Description
    SecondFactorLockout
    find(UUID userId)
    Reads the state of a user.
    SecondFactorLockout
    lockForUpdate(UUID userId)
    Reads the state of a user and locks it until the end of the current transaction, creating a clean state first when nothing was recorded, so that concurrent verifications of the same user's second factor run one after the other instead of all passing the lockout check before any of their failures is counted.
    SecondFactorLockout
    recordFailure(UUID userId, int maxAttempts, Duration lockout, Instant now)
    Records one failed attempt and, when the counter reaches the maximum, locks the second factor.
